description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing Git pack index functionalities, including creation, verification, corruption detection, and handling of 64-bit offsets. It contains test cases and functions that automate Git repository setup, pack creation, index validation, and error handling.

methods.name: index_obj_nr
methods.description: Returns the object number within a pack index file based on the object's SHA1.

methods.name: index_obj_offset
methods.description: Returns the pack offset for a given object SHA1 as recorded in the index file.
